 This is a paid press release. Contact the press release distributor directly with any inquiries. CPSC Posts Product Recalls and Product Safety Warnings to its Web Site
 PR Newswire Thu, November 19, 2026 at 10:45 AM EST 4 min read WASHINGTON, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The CPSC announces today the following recalls conducted in cooperation with the firms listed below. CPSC is also announcing product safety warnings for dangerous products that companies have not agreed to recall. Recalls and product safety warnings can be viewed at www.cpsc.gov . There are safety incidents, injuries, and death associated with some of these recalls and product safety warnings. 
 The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission is an independent federal agency created by Congress in 1973 and charged with protecting the American public from unreasonable risks of serious injury or death from more than 15,000 types of consumer products under the agency's jurisdiction. To report a dangerous product or a product-related injury, call the CPSC hotline at 1-800-638-2772, or visit http://www.saferproducts.gov. Further recall information is available at http://www.cpsc.gov. Xentrawave Recalls Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; One Death Reported 
 Xentrawave Recalls Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; One Death Reported | CPSC.gov 
 About 2,114 units 
 CPSC has received one report of a death involving the Xentrawave adult portable bed rail, model XT016. In 2026, an 89-year-old woman died from asphyxiation after she became entrapped between the bed rail and mattress. 
 Kidsview Recalls Infant Bouncers Due to Risk of Collapse and Impact Injury to Infants 
 Kidsview Recalls Infant Bouncers Due to Risk of Collapse and Impact Injury to Infants | CPSC.gov 
 About 412 units 
 Kidsview has received 7 reports of the bouncer collapsing while in use, including two incidents in which the infant's head struck the underlying surface. One consumer reported seeking medical attention for their infant. 
 Vanderhall Recalls Brawley GTS Electric Recreational Off Highway Vehicles (ROVs) Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard 
 Vanderhall Recalls Brawley GTS Electric Recreational Off Highway Vehicles (ROVs) Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard | CPSC.gov 
 About 220 units 
 The firm has received 6 reports of the vehicles' braking system unexpectedly locking while airborne. No injuries have been reported. 
 Ororo Recalls Rechargeable Lithium-Ion Battery Packs Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards 
 Ororo Recalls Rechargeable Lithium-Ion Battery Packs Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards | CPSC.gov 
 About 269 units 
 Ororo has received one report of the battery pack overheating. No injuries have been reported. 
 Cipton Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Head Injury; Violate Mandatory Standard for Bicycle Helmets 
 Cipton Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Head Injury; Violate Mandatory Standard for Bicycle Helmets | CPSC.gov 
 Story Continues About 16,730 units

 About 101,282 units

 Qpancy Recalls Children's Pajama Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standards for Children's Sleepwear | CPSC.gov 
 About 1,309 units

 About 490 units

 CPSC Warns Consumers to Stop Using FZChenrry Magnetic Fidget Ball Toys Immediately Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys | CPSC.gov 
 About CPSC 
 CPSC is the federal agency charged with protecting the public from unreasonable risks of injury associated with thousands of types of consumer products. Deaths, injuries, and property damage from consumer product-related incidents cost the nation more than $1 trillion annually. Since the agency was established more than 50 years ago, CPSC has worked to ensure the safety of consumer products, contributing to a decline in related injuries. 
 Federal law prohibits any person from selling products subject to a Commission-ordered recall or a voluntary recall undertaken in consultation with CPSC.  
 For lifesaving information: 
- Visit CPSC.gov. 
- Sign up to receive our e-mail alerts. 
- Follow us on  Facebook , Instagram , X , BlueSky , Threads , LinkedIn  and Truth Social .

- Call CPSC's Hotline at 800-638-2772 (TTY 800-638-8270). 
- Contact a media specialist .
